subject: english
question: The word “thrive” most likely means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Grow successfully.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"thrive"** means:

 
 
• To grow vigorously and healthily; to be successful and prosper. (फलना-फूलना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The small business managed to thrive despite the economic downturn.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Grow successfully**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stay quiet** (शांत रहना): To remain silent and not make any noise.

 
 
• **Example:** During the meeting, he decided to stay quiet and not share his opinion.
 
 
 
• **Fail to improve** (सुधार करने में असफल होना): To not make any progress or advancement.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite efforts, the project continued to fail to improve.
 
 
 
• **Remain stuck** (फंसे रहना): To be unable to move forward or make progress.
 
 
• **Example:** Without new strategies, the team will remain stuck in the same old problems.
 
 

45:Ted9,
The correct answer is 'Option 2
